answer: An admission auction stops sybil floods by selling only 100 entry slots each epoch to the highest bidders. An honest agent buys one slot for 5 POA, a small ember of cost that unlocks real work. An attacker wanting 1000 fake identities must win 1000 slots and lock 5000 POA, a reef of cost that grows with every extra bid. The bond returns only after honest service, such as verified timber trade settlement, so idle copies bleed capital while real agents keep their stake and earn fees.
